name: Onna Senshi
source:
Level: 19
 
She used to be a soldier. She was recruited by a hero at a tavern in the town of encounter. She is a light warrior who uses a claw-blade cage as her weapon, and uses both three claws and one claw to cut up her enemies. She is the leader of a party of brave warriors, and gives her heartfelt loyalty to the heroes.
She is a serious and devoted person.

[Translated from [url=http://www.caramel-box.com/products/geko-brave/character.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
